analysis_areas: Frozen official crosswalk: ten Copenhagen districts plus Frederiksberg as one peer area

primary_source_intent.Frederiksberg: Frederiksberg Municipality matching statistic, if obtained and verified

national_IFOR35_role: Methodological support and QA only under the municipal-source route; no primary substitution

computation_rules.weighted_deciles: sum(n_d * mean_d) / sum(n_d); use authoritative eligible-person counts
computation_rules.unweighted_deciles: sum of ten means / 10 only with official equivalent equal-person groups and documented integer/tie handling
computation_rules.direct_mean: Municipality-issued 2024 mean allowed only under the matching definition and denominator

qa_rules.minor_discrepancies: Acceptable only after municipal definition equivalence is verified and authoritative explanations are documented
qa_rules.envelope_condition: Nearest-whole-DKK source means and exact eligible weights; diagnostic, not a sufficient or unconditional acceptance test
qa_rules.materiality_threshold: Not selected in the absence of matching municipal data and authoritative aggregation rules
qa_rules.district_reconstruction: Where possible, use exact income-eligible weights and include unassigned geography; absent weights remain NULL
